<Heading

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/campaign/launch"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Creates a campaign from the body (as `POST /campaign`) and launches it with `executor` (as `POST /campaign/{id}/launch`) in one call. The campaign is saved only when the launch passes its checks; the run's `campaign` is its id.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>
